Chapter 4 — Full stack

Open a file, edit a wall name, then tessellate a few meshes.

Starting…

1. Open the file

await runtime.loadPlugin('schema', 'ifc4');
const model = ifcopenshell.open(bytes, 'sample.ifc');
Waiting…

2. Get and edit an element

const walls = model.byType('IfcWall');
walls[0].Name = 'Edited in full example';
Waiting…

3. Tessellate

await runtime.loadPlugin('mapping', 'ifc4');
await runtime.loadPlugin('kernel', 'manifold');
const settings = new geom.Settings();
settings.set('weld-vertices', false);
const iterator = new geom.Iterator(settings, model, {
  geometryLibrary: 'manifold',
});
if (iterator.initialize()) do {
  const shape = iterator.get();
  const tri = shape.asTriangulationElement();
  const nativeGeometry = tri.geometry();
  const faces = nativeGeometry.facesBuffer(Uint32Array);
  nativeGeometry.destroy();
  tri.destroy();
  shape.destroy();
  if (!faces.length) continue;
} while (iterator.next());
Waiting…

4. Log the result

console.log(walls[0].Name, meshes.length);
